verdicts.verify_by: grep -n 'AssetsPath\|assets-path' gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/main.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go to confirm an operator can set an absolute assets path; then a handler test with Static.AssetsPath="https://cdn.example/" and CanonicalOrigin set, asserting the og:image href
verdicts.tldr: AssetsPath can never be an absolute URL: NewRouter rewrites it to a rooted path before StaticMetadata sees it
verdicts.details: NewRouter sanitizes cfg.AssetsPath with "/" + strings.Trim(cfg.AssetsPath, "/") + "/" at app.go:132 and stores that value as StaticMetadata.AssetsPath at app.go:166. Every asset (CSS, JS, chroma style) is therefore served from a same-origin path, and og:image joining CanonicalOrigin with that path matches the rest of the page. gnoweb/main.go exposes no assets-path flag (the only assets hit is "disable assets caching" at main.go:251), so no operator can configure a CDN origin. Fix: none needed.
verdicts.evidence: read only: app.go:132 assetsBase := "/" + strings.Trim(cfg.AssetsPath, "/") + "/" // sanitize; app.go:166 AssetsPath: assetsBase; grep of main.go for Assets|assets returns only line 251 "disable assets caching"
